CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_order_actor_scope(p_uid uuid, p_partner uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = p_uid AND p.ativo) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_SCOPE_INACTIVE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF public.has_role(p_uid,'administrador') OR public.has_role(p_uid,'gestor_comercial') THEN
    IF platform_private.c2_internal_order_target_reason(p_uid, p_partner) IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_partner' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  END IF;
END $function$
functions.name: c2_order_actor_scope

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.solid_pack_presentation_link()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.catalogo_volumes cv WHERE cv.id = NEW.id AND cv.medida = 'embalagem'
                   AND cv.produto_id = NEW.product_id AND cv.owner_organization_id = NEW.owner_organization_id
                   AND cv.ativo IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.ativo) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRESENTATION_LINK_MISMATCH' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_accounting_pending_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- While pending, only commercial review/quote, rejection or cancellation are possible: no approval,
 -- credit decision, economics seal, receivable, production, NF or delivery.
 -- INSERT: the canonical create may land in em_analise_comercial, aguardando_cotacao or (insufficient credit)
 -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito; nothing operational/financial may be set at creation.
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' AND (
     NEW.status::text NOT IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','aguardando_aprovacao_credito')
     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approved_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1'
    AND NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' THEN
  -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito may only stay as is (no hidden credit decision) or leave to cancel/reject.
  IF NOT (NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','cancelado','reprovado')
          OR (NEW.status=OLD.status AND OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito'))
     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito' AND NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao'))
     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_at OR NEW.approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_at
     -- review e1e9aa2f: no credit/financial decision field may advance by any privileged path while pending.
     OR NEW.credit_approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_by OR NEW.credit_approval_notes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approval_notes
     OR NEW.approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_by
     -- review 61b28: the canonical create (same txn, private create ticket) initializes not_required -> pending/not_required;
     -- any other change (e.g. -> approved) is a financial decision and stays denied while pending.
     OR (NEW.financial_approval_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.financial_approval_status
         AND NOT (platform_private.has_ticket('c2_external_order_create',NEW.partner_id)
                  AND OLD.financial_approval_status='not_required' AND NEW.financial_approval_status IN ('pending','not_required'))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
functions.name: c2_accounting_pending_guard

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_attempt_journal_write_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '5s'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Also fences old function bodies in flight and arbitrary old/downgraded clients.
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.partner_id,NEW.idempotency_key,NEW.created_by)
  IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.partner_id,OLD.idempotency_key,OLD.created_by) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2DJ_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Fail BEFORE any scope lock; this trigger NEVER acquires scope (old body may hold idem).
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.partner_order_attempt_journal j
  WHERE j.actor_id=auth.uid() AND j.partner_id=NEW.partner_id AND j.idempotency_key=btrim(NEW.idempotency_key)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2DJ_REGISTERED_ATTEMPT_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('b2b_idem:'||NEW.partner_id::text||':'||btrim(NEW.idempotency_key),0));
 PERFORM platform_private.c2_partner_order_attempt_authz(auth.uid(),NEW.partner_id);
 IF NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2DJ_ACTOR_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.partner_order_attempt_journal j JOIN public.profiles p
  ON p.user_id=j.actor_id AND p.organization_id=j.organization_id AND p.ativo
  WHERE j.actor_id=auth.uid() AND j.partner_id=NEW.partner_id AND j.idempotency_key=btrim(NEW.idempotency_key)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2DJ_SCOPE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_packaging_item_snapshot_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
-- Snapshot de embalagem: no INSERT precisa casar com a embalagem/preço/unidade reais; depois é imutável
-- (cotação só pode mudar colunas de preço). Linhas legadas nunca ganham snapshot de embalagem por UPDATE.
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.packaging_id_snapshot IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.product_packagings k
                    JOIN public.product_sale_units s ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.owner_organization_id = k.owner_organization_id
                    JOIN public.catalogo_precos_embalagem c ON c.id = NEW.packaging_price_id_snapshot AND c.packaging_id = k.id
                         AND c.produto_id = k.product_id AND c.owner_organization_id = k.owner_organization_id
                   WHERE k.id = NEW.packaging_id_snapshot AND k.product_id = NEW.product_id
                     AND k.codigo = NEW.packaging_codigo_snapshot AND k.version = NEW.packaging_version_snapshot
                     AND k.peso_liquido_kg = NEW.packaging_peso_liquido_kg_snapshot
                     AND s.unidade_conteudo = NEW.packaging_unidade_conteudo_snapshot) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_PACKAGING_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.packaging_id_snapshot, NEW.packaging_codigo_snapshot, NEW.packaging_version_snapshot, NEW.packaging_peso_liquido_kg_snapshot,
      NEW.packaging_unidade_conteudo_snapshot, NEW.packaging_price_id_snapshot)
     IS DISTINCT FROM
     (OLD.packaging_id_snapshot, OLD.packaging_codigo_snapshot, OLD.packaging_version_snapshot, OLD.packaging_peso_liquido_kg_snapshot,
      OLD.packaging_unidade_conteudo_snapshot, OLD.packaging_price_id_snapshot)
     OR (OLD.packaging_id_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.product_id, NEW.quantidade, NEW.unidade_medida, NEW.volume_ml, NEW.order_id)
          IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.product_id, OLD.quantidade, OLD.unidade_medida, OLD.volume_ml, OLD.order_id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_PACKAGING_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_partner_packaging_offers_secure(p_partner_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
-- Leitor do comprador: embalagens inteiras ativas, publicadas e com preço vigente do vendedor do parceiro.
-- Mesmo guard canônico do catálogo; preco_tabela_brl é só exibição — o pedido é sempre recalculado no servidor.
DECLARE v_seller uuid; v_offers jsonb; v_solids jsonb;
BEGIN
  v_seller := platform_private.b2b_partner_catalog_reader(p_partner_id);
  IF v_seller IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'partner_not_found' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'product_id', k.product_id, 'unidade_conteudo', s.unidade_conteudo,
           'packaging_id', k.id, 'codigo', k.codigo, 'descricao', k.descricao, 'rotulo', cv.rotulo,
           'peso_liquido_kg', k.peso_liquido_kg, 'version', k.version, 'preco_tabela_brl', c.preco_brl)
         ORDER BY k.product_id, k.peso_liquido_kg, k.codigo, k.id), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_offers
    FROM public.product_packagings k
    JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT g.item_id FROM public.get_partner_catalog_secure(p_partner_id) g WHERE g.item_tipo = 'produto') g ON g.item_id = k.product_id
    JOIN public.produtos pr ON pr.id = k.product_id AND pr.owner_organization_id = v_seller AND pr.ativo IS TRUE AND COALESCE(pr.b2b_enabled, true) IS TRUE
    JOIN public.product_sale_units s ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.owner_organization_id = v_seller AND s.unidade_conteudo IN ('kg','g','ml','l')
    JOIN public.catalogo_volumes cv ON cv.id = k.id AND cv.medida = 'embalagem' AND cv.ativo IS TRUE AND cv.produto_id = k.product_id AND cv.owner_organization_id = v_seller
    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(c.preco_brl) AS preco_brl, count(*) AS n FROM public.catalogo_precos_embalagem c
                   WHERE c.packaging_id = k.id AND c.produto_id = k.product_id AND c.owner_organization_id = v_seller AND c.ativo IS TRUE
                     AND c.valid_from <= current_date AND (c.valid_until IS NULL OR c.valid_until >= current_date)) c ON c.n = 1
   WHERE k.owner_organization_id = v_seller AND k.ativo IS TRUE AND k.valid_from <= now() AND (k.valid_to IS NULL OR k.valid_to > now());
  -- Sólidos confirmados (kg/g) do catálogo autorizado, COM ou SEM oferta vigente: o comprador nunca cai no modo líquido
  -- por falta de preço/apresentação; a ausência de oferta é dita como tal. Sem preço, sem embalagem.
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('product_id', pr.id, 'unidade_conteudo', s.unidade_conteudo) ORDER BY pr.id), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_solids
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT g.item_id FROM public.get_partner_catalog_secure(p_partner_id) g WHERE g.item_tipo = 'produto') g
    JOIN public.produtos pr ON pr.id = g.item_id AND pr.owner_organization_id = v_seller AND pr.ativo IS TRUE AND COALESCE(pr.b2b_enabled, true) IS TRUE
    JOIN public.product_sale_units s ON s.product_id = pr.id AND s.owner_organization_id = v_seller AND s.unidade_conteudo IN ('kg','g');
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('contract', 'B2B_PARTNER_PACKAGING_ORDER_V1', 'partner_id', p_partner_id, 'offers', v_offers, 'solid_products', v_solids);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_credit_exposure(p_partner_id uuid, p_new_order_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_exclude_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit numeric(14,2); v_open numeric(14,2); v_overdue numeric(14,2);
  v_committed numeric(14,2); v_pending numeric(14,2);
  v_new numeric(14,2) := ROUND(COALESCE(p_new_order_amount,0),2);
  v_proj numeric(14,2); v_disp numeric(14,2); v_pct numeric;
  v_tolerance int; v_block boolean; v_action text; v_reason text;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(credit_limit,0), COALESCE(overdue_tolerance_days,0),
         COALESCE(block_if_overdue,false), COALESCE(credit_limit_action,'block')
    INTO v_limit, v_tolerance, v_block, v_action
  FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id;
  v_limit := COALESCE(v_limit,0); v_tolerance := COALESCE(v_tolerance,0);
  v_block := COALESCE(v_block,false); v_action := COALESCE(v_action,'block');

  -- (a) recebiveis em aberto do parceiro
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_open
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE');

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_overdue
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    AND ari.due_date < (current_date - v_tolerance);

  -- (b) pedidos com compromisso financeiro real e SEM recebivel gerado
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_committed
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega',
                      'confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  -- (c) H4-001: pedidos vivos ainda nao aprovados ja consomem limite.
  --     Sem isso, N pedidos em analise passavam individualmente no teste
  --     de credito e estouravam o limite ao serem aprovados.
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_pending
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('pendente','solicitado','em_analise_comercial',
                      'aguardando_aprovacao_credito','aguardando_ajuste_comercial',
                      'aguardando_itens')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  v_proj := ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending + v_new, 2);
  v_disp := GREATEST(v_limit - v_proj, 0);
  v_pct  := CASE WHEN v_limit > 0 THEN ROUND((v_proj / v_limit) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END;

  v_reason := CASE
    WHEN v_block AND v_overdue > 0 THEN 'OVERDUE_BLOCK'
    WHEN v_limit <= 0 THEN 'NO_LIMIT_DEFINED'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit AND v_action = 'approval_required' THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_APPROVAL'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BLOCK'
    ELSE 'OK' END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'partner_id', p_partner_id,
    'credit_limit', v_limit,
    'saldo_em_aberto', v_open,
    'saldo_vencido', v_overdue,
    'comprometido_nao_faturado', v_committed,
    'comprometido_pendente', v_pending,
    'novo_pedido', v_new,
    'exposicao_atual', ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending, 2),
    'exposicao_projetada', v_proj,
    'credito_disponivel', v_disp,
    'percentual_utilizado', v_pct,
    'overdue_tolerance_days', v_tolerance,
    'block_if_overdue', v_block,
    'credit_limit_action', v_action,
    'tem_vencidos', v_overdue > 0,
    'reason_code', v_reason
  );
END $function$
functions.name: fn_b2b_credit_exposure

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_condition_cfg_actor(p_admin_only boolean)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
BEGIN
  v_org := platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
  IF v_uid IS NULL OR v_org IS NULL OR public.is_platform_superadmin(v_uid) IS NOT FALSE
     OR NOT (public.has_role(v_uid,'administrador'::public.app_role) IS TRUE OR (NOT p_admin_only AND public.has_role(v_uid,'financeiro'::public.app_role) IS TRUE))
     OR public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b'::public.app_role) IS NOT FALSE OR public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::public.app_role) IS NOT FALSE
     OR public.has_role(v_uid,'cliente_produtor'::public.app_role) IS NOT FALSE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN v_org;
END $function$
